title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Acquires Huntington's Disease Drug Developer
summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) agreed to acquire UK based LoQus23 Therapeutics to advance an oral therapy for Huntington's disease. The deal gives Lilly access to LoQus23's targeted small molecule program that aims to address underlying drivers of Huntington's disease. The acquisition broadens Eli Lilly's neuroscience research footprint beyond its existing cardiometabolic and oncology focus areas.
